reason: The defect is real: revenue_ttm/net_income_ttm are verbatim yfinance totalRevenue/netIncomeToCommon, stamped field_meta status 'ok' with no basis label, for a company whose filings cannot produce a true TTM (only Dec-25/Mar-26/Jun-26 quarters exist; Jul-Sep 2025 sits inside a half-year filing). But the value is not shown to be wrong: the FY26 annual (21.21 cr / 8.07 cr) is a different period, so the '12.7% below' comparison is as-of/definitional skew by the diff stage's own rules. The true Jul-25..Jun-26 revenue must lie in [22.25, 25.56] cr (3 filed quarters + 0..3.31 cr of H1), and the app's 23.90 cr is inside that range. Severity is corrected from high to medium: this is an unlabelled interpolation presented as fact, not a demonstrably wrong figure.

repro_check: curl -s 127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/JONJUA at 2026-09-23T01:21Z -> revenue_ttm 239033504.0, net_income_ttm 87482000.0, growth_basis mrq_yoy, field_meta.revenue_ttm {status: ok, label: null}. Feasible true TTM = 22.25 + [0, 3.31] cr, and 23.90 lies inside it.

reason: Holds and re-reproduced live. The plain /fundamentals route serves yfinance heldPercentInsiders 0.46623 with field_meta status 'ok', and the panel renders it as 'Insiders' 46.6%. The app's own BSE-sourced shareholding shows promoter 29.67% for the latest pattern, and no recent quarter supports 46.6% (the series reads 29.67, 28.67, 42.93, 44.1, 44.1, 22.89 ...). This is the same root cause and the same verdict as DAT-P12-1.

reason: The 502 is real. get_results_calendar calls only nse_provider.get_results_calendar, with no exchange gate and no BSE lane, and the router turns the ProviderError into a raw 502. The mechanism is misframed, though: this is an NSE-only feed by design (docstring 'The NSE results/board-meeting calendar', query described as 'NSE ticker'), so every BSE-only name has a coverage gap; it is not a routing bug that ignores a resolved exchange. Severity is corrected to medium, consistent with DAT-P2-7 and DAT-P7-2: no frontend code calls /disclosures/results, and the only in-product consumer (research) degrades softly. The calendar also carries no result figures, so the 'just-filed Q1 FY27 numbers' were never on this surface.

reason: Holds. No router exposes corporate actions: grepping sidecar/routers for corporate_action/bonus/split finds only unrelated string splits. nse_provider.get_corporate_actions exists, but it is NSE-only, and its only consumer (dividend_actions) extracts future-dated dividends alone. Bonuses, splits and rights are never modelled, and a BSE-only name like JONJUA gets nothing. For a scrip with two 2026 bonus issues (5:40, 7:24), per-share history and holdings context go silently stale. High fits 'a promise central to the product is missing' (screener.in-grade coverage).

reason: This is a taxonomy (definitional) difference, not a same-definition mismatch, so the diff stage's own rules say it is not a finding. The app serves the Yahoo/Morningstar taxonomy with yfinance provenance; BSE uses its own macro-sector scheme. BSE's own industry group for this scrip, per the pack, is 'Commercial Services & Supplies', which is a GICS Industrials industry, so 'Industrials / Specialty Business Services' puts JONJUA in the same business-services neighbourhood rather than 'the wrong universe entirely'. The pack also records that both exchange labels misdescribe the actual business, so no single classification is ground truth here. This is consistent with DAT-P4-5, where the same yfinance label was refuted for the same reason.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/P14_JONJUA.json:84-94 (BSE IGroup 'Commercial Services & Supplies'; note 'BOTH ARE MISLEADING vs the actual described business'); live GET /fundamentals/JONJUA field_meta.sector {provider: yfinance}
evidence_checked: Read the pack's sector/industry entries and re-ran GET /fundamentals/JONJUA on :52152 (sector Industrials, industry Specialty Business Services, provider yfinance). Checked the sibling verdicts DAT-P4-5 (refuted) and DAT-P8-1, where the cross-universe mismatch (Basic Materials vs Financial Services) was admitted.
repro_check: curl -s 127.0.0.1:52152/fundamentals/JONJUA -> sector 'Industrials', industry 'Specialty Business Services', field_meta.sector provider yfinance. This is a different taxonomy from BSE's 'Services / Consulting Services', within the same business-services group.

reason: The headline claim does not hold. The Equity Overview panel never renders dividend_per_share_ttm: it renders 'Dividend / share' = dividend_per_share 0.07 and 'Dividend yield' 2.16%. Those match the pack's bonus-adjusted DPS (0.0688) and screener's 2.16% yield exactly, so the dividend the user received is not shown as blank. dividend_per_share_ttm is null on the plain /fundamentals route by design; only research/fast.py fills it. What holds is the record/ex/payment date gap: dividend_actions reads only NSE corporate actions and only future-dated dividends, so a BSE-only name has no dividend event dates anywhere (the same gap as DAT-P9-3). Severity is lowered to low.
